note: Hand-written topical queries for the arXiv RAG bake-off — the 'is the top of the list any good' family, where many papers are relevant and none is THE answer. Paired EN/SV per CLAUDE.md invariant 6; the Swedish side is idiomatic research Swedish, not a gloss. Graded by an LLM judge in scripts/arxiv-eval.mjs --judge, so the set stays small enough to grade honestly.
